title: The Last Delivery
summary: Tell Kestrel what happened in the square, then take one last bag of letters to the Wayfarer camp up the north road.
ask: Kestrel: There you are! You were supposed to come and tell me what happened in the square. You're late, Runner.
Kestrel: The Association told me you'd died. I told them you were probably just running late, as usual.
Kestrel: So, what did you see?

done: Kestrel: A gate opened right under the bells? I didn't think that was even possible.
Kestrel: Well, thanks for coming to tell me, even if you're late.
Kestrel: I've got one last delivery for you. The Wayfarer camp up the north road has been waiting a week for these letters.
Kestrel: Go out through the High Gate and follow the road north. Hale's on the gate, he'll let you through.

steps.text: Leave the city through the High Gate
done: Hale: Got your licence? Good, go on through. It's not too dangerous out here near the city, but keep your eyes open.

steps.text: Take the letters to the Wayfarer camp up the north road

done: Ilse: You must be Kestrel's runner. Have you got our letters?
Ilse: Thank you! We've been waiting a whole week for these.
Ilse: Here, take an ember from our fire. Carry it with you, and when you find a spot you'd like to live, place it there. That'll be your home.

steps.text: Place your Ember where you want your home
Go back to Kestrel at the Roost
done: Kestrel: Good. That was your last delivery. You're a hunter now, not a courier.
Kestrel: Come back and visit when you can. Your room on the roof is still yours.
